issue.title: test_bare_init_yes_repairs_unreferenced_long_memory expects pre-sase-vk section 3
issue.description:
`tests/main/test_init_onboarding_memory.py::test_bare_init_yes_repairs_unreferenced_long_memory` fails in isolation on a tree that does not touch memory generation.

It asserts `## 3. Reference Memory` (and `### 3.1 \`sase/memory/cli_rules.md\``) in the AGENTS.md produced by `sase init memory`. After epic sase-vk, generated agent instructions number sections as:

1. Core Memory
2. Reference Memory
3. Memory Webs

so Reference Memory is section 2. Live `AGENTS.md` in this repo matches that numbering. The test was not updated when memory webs moved into their own section.

Not caused by `plan:202608/gate_shell_handoff_status_bucket.md` (TUI/gate-shell bucket projection only).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Failed twice on this tree: once as part of an escalated `just check` full-suite lane, then again as a serial isolated pytest run (0.40s call). Same assertion both times. The produced AGENTS.md uses the post-sase-vk section order; the test still expects the pre-sase-vk `## 3. Reference Memory` heading.

adjacent generated-AGENTS.md heading drift, different surface

payload.entry:
check-full on 0gd--mon (just check-full, 38216 passed / 6 failed) reproduced the same pre-sase-vk section-3 heading drift on four more init-memory tests, all asserting ### 3.1 long-note headings in generated AGENTS.md:

- tests/main/test_init_memory_managed_agents_descriptions.py::test_init_memory_managed_agents_renders_block_long_memory_descriptions
- tests/main/test_init_memory_managed_agents_descriptions.py::test_init_memory_allows_fenced_hash_in_long_memory_description
- tests/main/test_init_memory_managed_agents_frontmatter.py::test_tier2_section_heading_keeps_top_level_long_note_reachable
- tests/main/test_init_memory_plan.py::test_memory_plan_missing_tree_reports_create_actions_without_writing

Same root cause as the onboarding node already on this bead. Not caused by plan:202608/gate_shell_handoff_status_bucket.md (TUI/gate-shell bucket projection only). The sixth check-full failure is the unrelated sase-vl wait-prose flake.

payload.close_reason: The obsolete section expectations have been updated. 70dd1da617 changed the onboarding assertion to '## 2. Reference Memory'; 8b0c65476 updated it again for the ordered reference roster. The original onboarding node passes. The two old block/fenced-description nodes named in the supplementary note have been replaced by explicit rejection tests under the new description contract, rather than continuing to assert section 3. Current related init-memory tests were checked in this review; there is no pre-sase-vk heading contract left to restore.
